From fridge to fork

A good meal starts
with what’s already there.

A little less planning, a little more cooking. Meal Prep Assistant helps you turn ingredients on hand into a meal plan that fits your day.

01 / SNAP⌗

Give your fridge a close-up.

Photograph what’s in your fridge. Meal Prep Assistant identifies your ingredients and finds recipes that use what you already have.

02 / PICK☷

Your meal. Your kind of portion.

Choose a meal that sounds good and set the serving size. Cooking for one, a roommate, or tomorrow’s lunch? You decide.

03 / SHOP☑

Just the things you’re missing.

Get a shopping list for the ingredients you still need. Start with what’s on hand and fill in the gaps before you cook.

04 / COOK WITH CONFIDENCE

A little help, right
when you need it.

New to the kitchen? Get help while you cook, from understanding a recipe step to figuring out an ingredient swap.

IN THE KITCHEN
No spinach left. Can I use kale?

✦For this bowl, yes! Remove the tough stems, chop the leaves, and sauté a little longer until tender.
